front.title: BGP Extension for ECMP Group ID

abstract.t:
In AI training scenarios, per-flow ECMP is the mainstream load balancing technology. However, hash collision issues lead to imbalanced traffic distribution, adversely affecting application performance.
This document defines a new BGP Extended Community, BGP_EXT-COMM- ECMP-GROUPID, which carries an ECMP Group ID associated with a route. The ECMP Group ID allows an ingress router to map flows destined for different remote addresses to different local ECMP subgroups, providing finer-grained load distribution and resolving load imbalance caused by hash collisions.
